title: quilted electric blanket
text: quilted electric blanket. This does look like a luxury electric blanket.  Its soft and smooth.  But it is heavy - and a bit slick - my cotton quilt won't stay on top of it.  The cord is long and flat - the control has nice bright orange tabs - easy to see at night.  It warms quickly and maintains an even heat.  Wish it was a bit lighter.. but function is the most important.  Just be prepared to remove your top quilt before going to bed. I chose the gray - it is what I would consider a darker gray.  I like it.  I wanted to include a photo of the cleaning instructions.... a bit intense and confusing on a couple of points... but likely a language barrier/mistake in interpretation - but for some reason I wasn't allowed to upload the photo.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Beautyrest Plush Heated Blanket Pinsonic Quilt Super Soft Electric Throw, Controller with 10 Hours Auto Shutoff and 20 Heat Level Setting, King, Teal
features: NEAR ZERO EMF - Our electric blanket is engineered for lowest electromagnetic radiation possible. Designed this electric heating blanket with heat channels with an evenly spaced quilted design. 100% UL certified for maxium safety. 12 Feet 6 Inches controller cord length with a 6 foot power cord length.

THERAPEUTIC RELIEF - 20 Heat levels to find your comfort zone of your plush electric quilt blanket. Pre-heating feature allows our electric blankets to be snuggly warm before crawling into the covers. 10 hour max auto shut off setting for a sound sleep while soothing those aches and pains

ELECTRIC BILL SAVINGS - Along with the quilted plush softness, these heated blankets help save money. Compared to electric throw blanket or portable heated blanket, this is a thick blanket with soft knife edge for more warmth and coverage. Compatible with smart home outlet and automatic timer.

PINSONIC QUILTING - Diamond quilted technology by using an ultrasonic energy machine to create this beautiful pattern on our super soft blanket above the heat blanket layer. Thinner fuzzy quilt to compliment with any fuzzy comforter for extra warmth. Travel storage bag allows this portable heated blanket to be packed and ready.

5 Year Limited Warranty - That is 5 years of promise of savings and service including for our electric heated blanket and plush heated throw that is often used in home office and work office. Machine washable and can be used like a regular quilt blanket.
description: Keep cozy through the night with the Beautyrest Pinsonic Microlight Heated Quilt. A pinsonic pattern adorns this navy heated quilt giving it a rich texture, for a luxurious look. Two controllers (1 for Twin and Full Sizes) provide 20 temperature control settings so you can find the perfect comfort and a 10 hour auto shut-off timer ensures your safety. Perfect for use with the heat on or off, this heated quilt is sure to keep you comfortable and is machine washable for easy care. Limited 5-year on parts.
